relevant_laws.quote: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct right-turn signal duty for the selected freight-loading-zone right-turn cases
relevant_laws.notes: The selected cell is a right turn. Business or residential and other-area distances remain distinct; exact district and freight-zone status require independent site source review.
